observation.command:
set -a && . /workspace/.env && set +a
for db in jura-db begruendungen-db; do
  echo "=== $db ==="
  docker exec workspace-postgresql-1 psql -U postgres -d "$db" -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public';" 2>&1
done
echo "=== process-compose: any non-running/non-completed? ==="
curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:8080/processes | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const d=JSON.parse(s).data;const bad=d.filter(p=>!["Running","Completed"].includes(p.status)||p.exit_code!==0);console.log("bad:",JSON.stringify(bad.map(p=>({n:p.name,st:p.status,ec:p.exit_code}))));console.log("healthy all:",d.filter(p=>p.has_ready_probe).every(p=>p.is_ready==="Ready"))})'
